section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1969
title: 15 ## ALL-INDIA SURVEY During the year 1969, 43,633 suicides were reported in India as against 40,688 during 1968, indicating an increase of 7.2%. Table 6 presents the comparative incidence of suicides during the last 6 years. It may be observed that the trend in suicides is consistently on an increase from 1965 onwards, i.e. it increased from 30,669 cases during 1965 to 43,633 cases during 1969. The volume of suicides i.e. per one lakh of population also increased from 6.3 during 1965 to 8.1 during 1969. The increase in suicides during the last 5 years was 43.3%, while increase in the population was 10.2% during the same period, indicating thereby that the rate of growth of suicides was approximately 4 times the rate of growth of population.
